body:
This is a story of how a three year old acid tab tricked me into thinking it was a dud, then caught me by surprise for the next ten hours. I also forgot it was 3 drops instead of 1
It was about 2:15 pm on a warm, bright sunny day, however the incoming parade of bulky, pillow like clouds was quickly suffocating that beautiful sun. I had just arrived at a park 40 minutes away. After I prepared my backpack with my essential materials (backpacking stove, tea, portable speaker, fruit, breakfast bars, etc.), I put the tab on my tongue and began my walk inside taking the first trail into the woods of the park. With the confidence that I would not see people, I was very comfortable in the environment.
NOTE: Last time I dosed, it was in the same place but the acid was very weak or somehow lost its potency (no other guesses). The same acid worked for 3 other people but not me, but its perfectly okay.
TWO HOURS LATER
At this point I began to think it was too old, or just not very strong. This didnt make sense though since it was really strong having been three drops instead of one. It couldnt take longer than two hours could it?! I decided to give it another half hour just to be certain. Ten minutes later I was giggling and having an amazing time. Never have I changed that quickly. Usually it was gradual, and I could feel that sort of tingle high frequency feeling for a while before I felt it. This was surprising to me, but it was now after 4pm so time was slipping away. It was now getting dark and gloomy but that didnt seem to matter.
NEXT THREE HOURS
I walked around, packed real green bowls and periodically enjoyed the fresh breath. I came up with calling it happiness and thought that was the greatest thing in the world. I'm going outside for some happiness... perfect.
ANYWAY
I was swinging a walking stick left and right like I was slicing bushes down from my path for the rest of my foot travels. I then climbed some trees, and while I do this all the time, it was the first time I did it on acid and it was a great feeling.
THREE HOURS LATER (spongebob..)
I had to go home, though I was still tripping so I decided to get some help.
I called a friend and he told me that if I felt it would be safe for me to do it, I can. I just have to trust myself.   Man-o-man,  Id be damned if those werent the best words of wisdom haha. I drove 40 minutes home, it was fine, I occasionally over-freaked myself out. Driving is so natural to me that I needed to anchor myself in the moment, all I was doing was driving. So you could say I meditated the whole way home. Remarkable. I walked inside to my parents eating dinner at the table with all the lights on Italian music blasting. I rushed upstairs like I had to poop. Could not deal with that setting.
Rest of the night, hit the bong, played skyrim, periodically did some breathing exercises to enhance the visuals I get with my eyes closed.
3:30 AM was the end of the trip, and what a trip it was.
[Erowid Note: 
Driving while intoxicated, tripping, or extremely sleep deprived is dangerous and irresponsible because it endangers other people.
Don't do it!
]
